text:
mike: Customer reports intermittent 504s + duplicate billing when we cancel contexts from the Go client. Happens under load, sometimes the request shows as canceled locally but we still see downstream processing. Repro steps below.
jen: Can you paste a minimal repro and the go-sdk version + http.Client config?
mike: minimal snippet: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Second)
defer cancel()
req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", url, bytes.NewReader(body))
resp, err := client.Do(req)
// client is &http.Client{Timeout: 5 * time.Second, Transport: tr}
```
we're on redwood-go v0.13.0, Transport is default with IdleConnTimeout left as default.
ingrid: Any SDK-level retries enabled? Logs might show if the SDK retried after context cancel. If the body was fully sent before cancel, server could still commit while client cancels — retrying would cause duplicate work.
mike: logs: "2026-03-10T14:02:11Z INFO request_id=abc123 err=\"context canceled\""
"2026-03-10T14:02:12Z INFO request_id=abc123 decision=retried"
"2026-03-10T14:02:12Z INFO request_id=def456 status=200 cost=0.023"
we see the SDK issuing a retry for the same logical operation.
ryan: This looks like a retry-on-canceled-context bug/unsafe-default. Quick tips: 1) confirm whether the SDK is configured to retry on any network error — if so, it may treat context.Canceled as transient. 2) In Go the timing matters: if the request body made it to server before ctx cancel, retrying can duplicate side effects.
Workarounds: set the SDK retry policy to NOT retry on context.Canceled, or upgrade to redwood-go >= v0.14.1 which adds a flag to avoid retrying on ctx cancel. Also consider using client.Transport = &http.Transport{DisableKeepAlives: true} for idempotent endpoints during debugging, and prefer letting the request ctx control timeouts (avoid also setting Client.Timeout unless you want hard aborts).
mike: I'll try bumping to v0.14.1 and set RetryOnCtxCancel=false, and test with DisableKeepAlives=true. If that doesn't repro-fix, please escalate. request id abc123 for the failing traces. :thumbsup:
support-bot: Escalation created: INC-2026-072 — assigned to eng-sre. :rotating_light:
ryan: If you can't reproduce after upgrade please paste a trace + full http.Transport config (MaxIdleConnsPerHost, IdleConnTimeout) and I'll take it to eng-runtime. :thinking_face:
